item.title: New bills would require election of Michigan Public Service Commissioners
item.description: DELTA TOWNSHIP, Mich. (WLNS) - A group of Democrats in the state House of Representatives are aiming to give the public more control over the Michigan Public Service Commission. item.title: 4 dead, several injuries after Southwest Michigan tornadoes
item.description: Four people were killed as a strong storm ripped through Southwest Michigan Friday, spawning at least three tornadoes.
